module: Outgoing bridge from the Lua router to the UI frameworks (Vue, Angular) via guihooks. It emits the route change events (start, end, cancellation) and keeps no state: transition state, progress, timeouts and acknowledgment validation are in transitionManager.lua and router.lua.
notes: When a transitionId is provided, a shallow copy of the payload is emitted with transitionId added: the original navigation entry is never modified. Existing fields (request, resolved, origin, toRoute, fromRoute, routeNode) are kept.
Emitted GUI events: ui_router_routeChange, ui_router_afterRouteChange (Constants.RouterHooks.AFTER_ROUTE_CHANGE), ui_router_routeChangeCancelled (ROUTE_CHANGE_CANCELLED).

sendRouteChange.desc: Emits the GUI event ui_router_routeChange to ask the framework to display the route.

transitionId.desc: Transition identifier to attach to the payload (copy).

sendRouteChangeComplete.desc: Emits the GUI event ui_router_afterRouteChange with the committed navigation entry.

sendRouteChangeCancelled.desc: Emits the GUI event ui_router_routeChangeCancelled. If extras contains transitionId or reason, a copy of the route is emitted with these fields so that the UI clears only the matching handoff.
